findings.text: §4's deliverable claims the refusal "covers ... a section body", and because the term check is added to the one shared predicate `_forged_plan_structure` it also reaches `append_evidence`, yet the done-when tests only the insert_section (case 1), create (case 2) and text-mode (case 3) routes and never exercises `set sections.<id>.body` or `append_evidence` — the two other routes the predicate change silently re-scopes
